pages.title: Assigning Spells
pages.text: Place a Magic Lens and a Diamond Engraver in the workbench. Pick a slot, then choose one of your known spells to inscribe into it. Each use of the engraver wears it down by one use.
You can only inscribe spells you already know. Spells are learned permanently from Ancient Spell Books - see the Spells category for more.
